data.author: luafox
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Apple设备和iCloud账户在被盗后的安全问题及账户恢复流程的争议

不同观点：
• crazygringo认为，Apple应该建立一个验证流程（如电话号码、信用卡、购买收据等）来帮助用户恢复账户，尤其是用户在Apple设备上花费了大量金钱，账户恢复是合理且必要的。他质疑是否因为法律责任问题，Apple不愿意介入账户恢复。

• nashashmi分享了一个实例，其亲戚的手机被盗后，小偷成功更改了iCloud账户的密码和邮箱，导致家人无法重置手机。这表明当前的账户安全措施存在漏洞，容易被不法分子利用。

• someonehere不信任Apple的账户安全机制，建议用户自行备份数据，并提供了两种备份方案（Backblaze云备份或本地硬盘备份）。他强调依赖Apple的风险性。

• gu009指出，在手机被盗后如何处理缺乏明确指导，Apple的官方建议没有涵盖实际盗窃中窃贼使用的社会工程手段。他建议Apple应区分“丢失”和“被盗”的情况，并提供更多针对性的保护措施。

• alabastervlog推测问题可能出在iCloud账户的“忘记密码”功能上，如果手机上保存了相关邮箱账户，小偷可以轻易获取iCloud账户的访问权限。

• mmmlinux持批评态度，认为很多问题是用户自己没有保管好终极恢复密码，而不是Apple的责任。

• anonym29以讽刺的语气批评了对大公司和政府的信任，认为用户不应盲目依赖Apple等大公司，建议考虑自托管、开源系统等替代方案。

• JCattheATM对消费者表示有限同情，认为将数字生活托管给大公司（如Apple）是有风险的，因为这些公司往往不关心个体用户。

• tacker2000认为Apple不应该介入账户恢复，尤其是在用户没有本地备份的情况下，数据丢失的责任应由用户自己承担。他质疑如果Apple开放恢复流程，如何在更大范围内有效执行。

• betimsl为Apple的加密机制辩护，指出Apple的端到端加密设计初衷是保护用户隐私，Apple自身无法解密数据，即使有传票要求也是如此。他认为Apple在隐私和安全之间选择了隐私。

补充讨论：
- 用户对Apple在账户安全和恢复方面的期望与Apple自身政策之间的矛盾。
- 对大公司（如Apple）的信任问题，部分用户认为不应完全依赖大公司。
- 具体案例（如nashashmi的亲身经历）揭示了当前系统中的安全漏洞。
- 对如何有效应对手机被盗后的账户安全问题提出了具体建议（如gu009的“标记为被盗”选项）。
- 账户恢复技术实现的可行性问题，包括如何在更大范围内操作以及数据隐私的保护。

data.title: Lichens can survive almost anything, and some might survive Mars
data.author: abacussh
data.article_summary: 文章主要探讨了地衣是否能在火星恶劣环境下生存。研究人员在模拟火星环境的条件下，测试了两种地衣（*Diploschistes muscorum*和*Cetrarea aculeata*）的生存能力。结果显示，这些地衣在低压、低温、高二氧化碳和强辐射的环境中，仍能保持一定的代谢活性。虽然两种地衣都表现出耐辐射能力，但*D. muscorum*比*C. aculeata*更具抗性，且其光合作用未受显著影响。研究表明，地衣可能具有在火星上生存的潜力，但具体生存能力取决于物种及其适应性。研究人员认为还需进一步研究以确认地衣能否真正适应火星环境。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于文章未提及Kim Stanley Robinson的《火星三部曲》的评论，以及对火星相关科幻作品的不同看法。

不同观点：
• [NoTeslaThrow] 认为文章遗漏了《火星三部曲》是严重的缺失，并对该作品给予高度评价。他认为这部作品是极少数同时具备硬科幻特性和乐观、生动角色描绘的佳作，值得读者关注。同时提到Ursula K. Le Guin的《一无所有》作为类似作品。
• [elevatedastalt] 以幽默的方式回应，提到自己误将"lichen"（地衣）看成"Lichess"（一个国际象棋网站），并以此表示对原评论的认同。
• [morkalork] 提出一个假设情景，即如果探测器污染导致地衣在火星上扩散，可能会产生尴尬后果。这种观点引入了对太空探测中生物污染问题的潜在担忧。
• [djaouen] 以简短幽默的方式评论，暗示与人类相比，地衣可能更适合或更有趣地存在于火星上。
• [contingencies] 用双关语"Mars: I'm lichen it"表达了对地衣和火星主题的兴趣，与之前的评论形成互动。

补充讨论：
• 评论中对《火星三部曲》的高度赞扬，尤其是其对地衣等自然元素的详尽描述，反映了部分读者对硬科幻作品中科学细节和世界构建的重视。
• 讨论中出现了对太空探索中生物污染问题的潜在关注，虽然是以幽默方式提出，但确实触及了科学界对行星保护的严肃话题。

Whether anything ever lived on Mars is unknown. And the present environment, with harsh temperatures, intense radiation, and a sparse atmosphere, isn’t exactly propitious for life. Despite the red planet’s brutality, lichens that inhabit some of the harshest environments on Earth could possibly survive there.
Lichens are symbionts, or two organisms that are in a cooperative relationship. There is a fungal component (most are about 90 percent fungus) and a photosynthetic component (algae or cyanobacteria). To see if some species of lichen had what it takes to survive on Mars, a team of researchers led by botanist Kaja Skubała used the Space Research Center of the Polish Academy of Sciences to expose the lichen species
Diploschistes muscorum
and
Cetrarea aculeata
to simulate Mars conditions.
“Our study is the first to demonstrate that the metabolism of the fungal partner in lichen symbiosis was active while being in a Mars-like environment,” the researchers said in a
study
recently published in IMA Fungus. “X-rays associated with solar flares and SEPs reaching Mars should not affect the potential habitability of lichens on this planet.”
Martian ionizing radiation is threatening to most forms of life because it can cause damage at the cellular level. It can also get in the way of physical, genetic, morphological, and biochemical processes, depending on the organism and radiation level.
Going to extremes
Lichens have an edge when it comes to survival. They share characteristics with other organisms that can handle high levels of stress, including a low metabolism, not needing much in the way of nutrition, and longevity. Much like tardigrades, lichens can stay in a desiccated state for extended periods until they are rehydrated. Other lichen adaptations to extreme conditions include metabolites that screen out UV rays and melanin pigments that also defend against radiation.
Because the effects of UV radiation on lichens have been studied before, Skubała decided to focus on something that had not previously been explored, which is what happens to them when exposed to ionizing radiation while they are still metabolically active (lichens need water to keep their metabolism going). To do so, the researchers sprayed the lichens with water for hydration to keep them in a metabolically active state.
Each species spent five hours inside a dark chamber with simulated Martian conditions. This meant
low pressure
, low humidity, an “atmosphere” that was mostly carbon dioxide, and temperatures that started at a daytime 18° C (64° F), then plunged down to a nighttime -26° C (-14° F). X-ray radiation levels in the chamber were similar to those on the surface of Mars when there is strong solar activity, although solar flares and fluctuations in solar wind make actual Martian levels unpredictable.
I’m a survivor
When the lichens emerged from their simulated Martian habitat, both species were found to have retained some moisture despite a lack of humidity, so the researchers assumed that at least some metabolic activity was going on in both the fungal and photosynthetic components. Earlier, the photosynthetic component of lichens
had been tested
during exposure to ionizing radiation, but not the fungal component.
Lichens that are not dehydrated are
more prone to damage
from ionizing radiation. Both fungal and algal cells in metabolically active lichens have repair mechanisms they can activate, but
D. muscorum
was much more resistant to the radiation than
C. aculeata.
This species suffered less
oxidative stress
, meaning that fewer
reactive oxygen species
built up in its cells. These unstable molecules contain oxygen and can severely damage cellular components and even lead to cell death.
Other adverse Martian conditions, such as an atmosphere dominated by carbon dioxide, can affect lichen metabolism but not completely shut it down. The fungal component needs oxygen so it can metabolize carbohydrates, but the metabolic processes of both species kept going even though there was little oxygen available. The researchers think it is also possible that the photosynthetic portion of the lichens might have produced oxygen that the fungal components could use.
Surprisingly, the process of photosynthesis was not that sensitive to X-rays in dark conditions. Fluorescence imaging measurements of chlorophyll concentrations showed that the photosynthetic component of
D. muscorum
remained undamaged throughout the experiment, while that in
C. aculeata
experienced a decrease in chlorophyll when exposed to X-rays. Both lichens were frozen after the experiment. When thawed, both became photosynthetically active again, with
C. aculeata
quickly regaining its initial chlorophyll levels.
Whether lichens can survive on Mars really depends on the species. Skubała thinks that further research is needed to determine al

data.title: How I use Kate editor
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary:
本文介绍了作者如何使用Kate文本编辑器进行编程工作，强调了其喜爱的功能和设置。Kate已有约20年历史，作者通过详细说明工作流和配置，鼓励更多人尝试。

**主要内容包括：**

1. **编辑器设置**：默认设置已能满足大部分需求，但可以根据个人习惯调整。
2. **常用插件**：包括构建与运行、颜色选择器、文档预览、Git blame、调试器、LSP客户端、终端等。
3. **视图与分屏**：通过标签页右键选项实现分屏，并按会话保存布局。
4. **语言服务器（LSP）**：可编辑用户服务器设置，覆盖默认配置。
5. **调试适配器**：类似LSP设置，需重启以应用更改。
6. **格式化工具**：可自定义代码格式化设置，禁用自动格式化。
7. **快捷键**：建议学习默认快捷键，但可根据个人习惯调整。
8. **路径设置**：用于解决语言服务器路径问题。
9. **会话管理**：将项目分组管理，不同会话对应不同项目，提高工作效率。
10. **配色方案**：使用KColorScheme库，可复制和修改配色方案。
11. **文件快速切换与操作搜索**：通过快捷键快速查找文件或操作，提高使用效率。

作者通过这些设置和技巧，极大提升了Kate编辑器的工作效率。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Kate文本编辑器的功能、优缺点以及是否能替代其他流行编辑器（如VSCode、Vim等）

不同观点：
• **支持Kate作为VSCode替代品**：
   - [tux3] 认为Kate在轻量级文本编辑和功能扩展之间找到了很好的平衡，适合那些不想用过于复杂的IDE但需要比简单笔记应用更多功能的用户。
   - [actuallyalys] 表示Kate可能成为其第二编辑器，尤其是在DAP支持和会话管理方面具有吸引力，尽管不会完全取代Neovim。
   - [ryukoposting] 曾使用Kate并对其多光标支持有良好印象，计划再次尝试。
   - [sangpugogogo] 发现Kate的LSP集成和会话处理功能非常有用，是一个轻量但不失功能的编辑器。

• **对Kate的UX和功能有保留意见**：
   - [bogwog] 认为Kate在用户体验上比Sublime有明显差距，尤其不喜欢KDE美学，认为其界面显得杂乱。
   - [AbuAssar] 指出Kate缺少Notepad++中非常有用的“书签所有匹配行”功能。
   - [alex1115alex] 认为Kate界面过于杂乱，功能上也不如VSCode强大，无法很好地替代Notepad.exe或VSCode。

• **对VSCode的批评及复杂性的讨论**：
   - [bobajeff] 提到VSCode变得越来越专有化，且扩展存在冲突问题，比如cpptools插件在非VSCode编辑器中的问题。
   - [otistravel] 批评Kate试图包揽一切功能，复杂性与VSCode无异，且认为使用大量插件后无法再称为“简单”的文本编辑器。
   - [larusso] 对VSCode变得臃肿感到不满，尤其在处理Python和Ruby文件时需要额外配置LSP，正在寻找更轻快的替代方案。

补充讨论：
• **特定功能需求**：
   - [HexDecOctBin] 强调Undo Tree功能的重要性，目前只有Vim/Neovim和Emacs支持，无法转向其他现代编辑器。
   - [bornfreddy] 关心Kate是否支持如转换大小写、生成序列号等小功能，这些功能在VSCode插件中非常实用。

• **历史和回忆**：
   - [pvg] 提供了一个一年前的讨论链接，显示出对Kate的长期关注。
   - [rgrieselhuber] 简单表达了对Kate的赞赏，称其为“隐藏的宝石”。

争议焦点：
• Kate是否真正提供了比VSCode更简单的编辑体验，还是仅仅在复杂性上换汤不换药。
• Kate的用户界面是否过于杂乱，影响使用体验。

43746433.article_content:
How I use Kate Editor
on  2025-04-20
I love the
Kate Text editor
. I use it for pretty much all the programming projects I do. Kate has been around for long time now, about 20 years! At least earliest blog post for it I could find was
written in 2004.
I wanted to go over my workflow with it, why I like it so much and hopefully get more people to try it out.
How I set up my editor
Here's some settings I find important for my workflow. There's tons more
settings to fiddle with, but most of the defaults suffice for me very well.
Plugins I use
Here's a list of the plugins I have enabled. Some of them are self-explanatory, some I will go more in detail later.
Build & Run
Color Picker
Colored Brackets
Document Preview
Docment Switcher
External Tools
Formatting
Git Blame
Kate Debugger
LSP Client
Open Link
Project Plugin
Search & Replace
Snippets
Terminal
Move and split views
In Kate, most views are in their own little tabs. You can right click these tabs and select "Own section" which splits them into their own areas. In the screenshot I provided at start, you can see my Projects and Git view being split like this, so they can both be open at the same time.
Do note that these are saved per session, so sessions can have different splits.
Language server
In LSP Client settings, you can toggle multiple things I won't go into detail in here.
What I do want to mention is the User Server Settings file, which can be edited from this menu.
To override some defaults, you can just copy the default setting from the default tab, put it in your own settings tab and then just change the values.
Here's my LSP settings:
dotfiles/kate/lspclient/settings.json
Debug adapters
Debugger settings work similarly to LSP setting, however you may have to restart Kate to recognize any new changes.
Here's my DAP settings:
dotfiles/kate/debugger/dap.json
Formatters
For code formatting, there's also it's own setting menu, however as of writing this
only the languages mentioned in default settings
are supported.
If you want to tell formatter to stop autoformatting, you can set it like this, using clang-formatter as example:
{
"clang-format"
: {
"command"
: [
"clang-format"
],
"formatModifiedLinesOnly"
:
true
,
"formatOnSave"
:
false
}
}
Here's my formatting settings:
dotfiles/kate/formatting/settings.json
Shortcuts
Shortcuts are very personal thing and I encourage learning the defaults if at all possible. I have changed mine around a bit, for example
Ctrl+Shift+Space
for Quick Open and
Ctrl+Space
for Find action. More of these two later!
Path setting
Kate can't always find language servers for example, if it can't resolve your path.
Use this path setting to load binaries from paths like
~/.local/bin
. You can find this under Behavior settings at least on Kate 25.04.
Sessions
Sessions are basically group of projects. Do not treat sessions as projects themselves, that will only cause sadness.
I have separated my Work and Personal projects in their own sessions. This means that during work day, I can right click the Kate icon, select Work session, and then Kate will always open for me in that session until I choose Personal session.
In session settings I have set Kate to always open the last used session because of this.
I highly recommend this way of working. You could also have sessions for differently themed projects: Gamedev, web, etc..
Just make sure to create at least one session when starting out, then you can use that as a template for the other sessions in Kate session manager.
When I used to write more notes with Kate, I had it's own Notes session with both my Notes folder as a project folder and my blog.
Colorschemes
Kate uses
KColorScheme
library for it's colorscheme needs. You can very easily to copy a ready colorscheme and then start modifying your own changes on top of it.
You can also create a completely new colorscheme if you wish, like I have done here:
Revontuli/Kate
The colorscheme files in the library are their own XML format which is not ideal IMO but it gets the job done.
It would be awesome if Kate supported
tree-sitter
but so far I haven't heard anyone trying to implement that.
File quick switching
I mentioned this earlier in shortcuts section. If you're like me and have multiple projects open, you can use the Quick switcher and start typing the filename you need to open.
If you just want to open a specific project, you can type
project bla
and it will find that project for you from your project list.
This is why I have it bound to
Ctrl+Shift+Space
, so I can just press it and quickly find the file I need.
Action search
This is more interesting: Instead of searching for files, you can search for any action Kate has.
For example, if you want to look for terminal related actions, you can type "Terminal" and it lists everything plus any potential shortcuts.
Fun fact, you can use this in other KDE apps too, like Dolphin or Konsole!
The default key combination for it is
ctrl+alt+i
but I use it so frequently I set it to
ctrl+spac

data.title: Propositional Parlor Puzzle
data.author: foldU
data.article_summary:
这篇文章讨论了一个名为《Blue Prince》的游戏中的逻辑谜题，特别是在“Parlor”房间里的谜题。这些谜题涉及三个盒子：蓝盒、白盒和黑盒，每个盒子会做出一些陈述。游戏规则要求至少有一个盒子只说真话，至少有一个盒子只说假话，且只有一个盒子中有奖品。文章通过具体例子说明如何分析这些陈述来找到奖品所在。

文章进一步提出使用命题逻辑来自动解决这些谜题，介绍了一些基本的逻辑概念和操作，如变量、与（And）、或（Or）、非（Not）。作者建议创建一个工具来自动验证谜题的正确性，并给出了用JavaScript风格表示这些逻辑元素的方法。通过这种方法，可以系统地解决谜题并确保一致性。

不同观点：
• [ddmf] 提到了自己在PS5上玩了一款名为《Blue Prince》的游戏，关注的是主机平台上的逻辑谜题游戏体验。

• [Supermancho] 则推荐了一款在STEAM平台上可获取的游戏《Mimic Logic》，强调了PC平台上类似的逻辑谜题游戏，提供了另一种选择。

• [millxing] 提出了不同的资源形式，推荐了已故作家Raymond Smullyan的书籍，提供了一种远离电子游戏的逻辑谜题体验，强调了传统书籍作为逻辑谜题的载体。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中提到了不同平台上的逻辑谜题资源，包括主机游戏（PS5）、PC游戏（STEAM），以及书籍，展现了逻辑谜题在多种媒介上的呈现方式。

• 争议焦点并不明显，但不同平台的偏好可能成为潜在的讨论点，例如有些人可能更偏好主机游戏体验，而另一些人可能更喜欢PC游戏或书籍的形式。

• 每位评论者都提供了具体的推荐内容，这为喜欢逻辑谜题的玩家提供了多样化的选择路径，从实际游戏到书籍资源均有涉及。

43755128.article_content:
April 21, 2025
Propositional Parlor Puzzle
I've recently been playing
Blue Prince
, which is a great time if you are a fan of puzzle games like Return of the Obra Dinn or Outer Wilds and also a fan of roguelike games like Slay the Spire.
One of the game's rooms, the Parlor, features a logic puzzle that is different on each run. In this post we'll be doing some modelling and analysis of these puzzles. Some people might consider that a spoiler!
In the parlor, there are three boxes, a blue box, a white box, and a black box. Each box makes some set of statements. We are also given the following rules:
There will always be at least one box that makes only true statements.
There will always be at least one box that makes only false statements.
There is a prize in exactly one box.
Here's one example of such a puzzle:
Blue: You are in the parlor
White: This box is empty
Black: The blue box is true
The blue box is making an obviously true statement—the box game always takes place in the Parlor. The black box thus is also making a true statement, since blue is true. Since we know by the rules that there must be at least one box making
false
statements, it can only be white, and so we can deduce that white is
not
empty and has the prize.
The puzzles get a bit trickier than this sometimes. Consider:
Blue: the gems are in a box with a true statement
White: the gems are in a box with a false statement
Black: The white box is true
There are actually two consistent interpretations here: both
Blue: true
White: false
Black: false
and
Blue: false
White: true
Black: true
are valid. The trick is that the game is not to determine which boxes are telling the truth, but where the prize is, and in this case, either interpretation gives that the prize is in the blue box.
Let's make a tool that solves these puzzles automatically! This might be useful, if, say, you were making this game and writing a lot of them and wanted some kind of mechanical assurance as part of a test suite that you hadn't made a mistake.
We can represent these puzzles using propositional logic. This is a kind of logic that is interested in the truth of specific statements. You might think of it as expressions over values only of type
bool
. We typically have four kinds of objects in propositional logic:
variables, like
foo
,
bar
,
negations
, which take a value and flip its result from true to false or false to true,
disjuncts
, or
OR
s over multiple other objects,
conjuncts
, or
AND
s over multiple other objects.
We can represent expressions like "it's cold outside and you should wear a coat" symbolically with variables for
ColdOutside
and
ShouldWearACoat
by writing
ColdOutside AND ShouldWearACoat
. Tough people might not need to wear a coat, so we could write
ColdOutside AND (ShouldWearACoat OR IsTough)
.
Something we are frequently interested in is, given an expression like this:
is there
an assignment of true/false to the variables that makes the expression true, and also
what are
all
the assignments of true/false to the variables that make the assignment true?
This problem is called SAT, for "satisfiability." We're asking if a given expression is satisfiable. As a simple example, the expression
A AND (NOT A)
is
not
satisfiable.
SAT solving is a deep topic and there are many fancy, powerful tools for solving SAT problems. Luckily we don't need all that machinery, our expressions are going to be simple enough that we can just brute force them, which is good since it's more fun to just do this stuff yourself.
Let's start by coming up with a way to represent true, false, and variables (excuse my JavaScript style, I haven't written it professionally in like ten years):
const
True
=
{
type
:
'true'
};
const
False
=
{
type
:
'false'
};
const
Var
=
name
=>
({
type
:
"var"
,
name
,
});
We can use this to come up with all the variables we will need to represent these problems:
const
BlueBoxIsTrue
=
Var
(
"BlueBoxIsTrue"
);
const
WhiteBoxIsTrue
=
Var
(
"WhiteBoxIsTrue"
);
const
BlackBoxIsTrue
=
Var
(
"BlackBoxIsTrue"
);
const
BlueBoxIsFalse
=
Var
(
"BlueBoxIsFalse"
);
const
WhiteBoxIsFalse
=
Var
(
"WhiteBoxIsFalse"
);
const
BlackBoxIsFalse
=
Var
(
"BlackBoxIsFalse"
);
const
BlueBoxHasGems
=
Var
(
"BlueBoxHasGems"
);
const
WhiteBoxHasGems
=
Var
(
"WhiteBoxHasGems"
);
const
BlackBoxHasGems
=
Var
(
"BlackBoxHasGems"
);
We have separate variables for both a box being True and False because a box is not necessarily one or the other if it makes multiple statements: it can have one statement that is true and one that is false, and the box itself is then not "true" or "false."
Next we need our operators,
And
,
Or
, and
Not
.
const
And
=
(...
terms
)
=>
{
return
{
type
:
'and'
,
terms
,
};
};
const
Or
=
(...
terms
)
=>
{
return
{
type
:
'or'
,
terms
,
};
};
const
Not
=
term
=>
{
return
{
type
:
'not'
,
term
,
};
};
Now we can use these to build more complicated expressions that represent the rules in our game.
Remember, at least one box is "true," and at least one box is "fal

An A.I. programmer responds to Annalee Newitz’s “
When Robot and Crow Saved East St. Louis
.”

In 2018 the A.I. robot
CIMON
was sent to the International Space Station—and that’s when the awkwardness began. A floating sphere with a digital face displaying a few simple expressions, CIMON was supposed to help astronauts through many-step procedures by displaying information and answering questions. When astronaut Alexander Gerst tested it, he found CIMON’s maneuverability impressive but its social awareness perhaps less so. It had been programmed to know Gerst’s favorite song, but had to be ordered multiple times to stop playing it. “Let’s sing along with those favorite hits,” it interrupted, as Gerst tried to get it to record video. Moments later it seemed to take exception to Gerst’s mild comments on its flying ability. “Don’t be so mean, please,” it told him. “Don’t you like it here with me?” Soon it seemed CIMON’s mood detection system had a “hangry” category and had confusedly placed Gerst in it. “Oh, dear, I feel you. I can already hear your stomach roaring. Should we take a look for when it is time for food?” CIMON was soon stowed away.
In Annalee Newitz’s story “When Robot and Crow Saved East St. Louis,” there’s another little round bot called, simply, Robot. Like CIMON, its job is to interact with people: Robot’s purpose is to monitor local humans for signs of disease to spot epidemics before they spread. Unlike CIMON, it’s so charming that I just want to pat its little robot head. “Hello,” it says. “I am your friendly neighborhood flu fighter! Please cough into this tissue and hold it up to the scanner please!” It gives plump-cheeked smiles and waves its tiny gripper arm.
Advertisement
Advertisement
Advertisement
Advertisement
Like CIMON, Robot one day reaches the limits of its programming. Robot travels beyond its initial route among gated communities and smart mansions to the less-gentrified neighborhoods across the river. There it encounters humans who speak languages and dialects it hasn’t been trained on, and humans living in buildings and tents that aren’t registered in any of its databases. It’s completely unprepared to work in these neighborhoods.
Robot should have failed. Algorithmic bias has been the downfall of many a modern-day A.I., from face-recognition software that
performs poorly on dark-skinned people
, to voice-recognition software that
can’t understand some voices
, to software that
perpetuates
or even
amplifies
biases in the human behaviors it copies.
But then, something magical happens. Robot recognizes that something is wrong and phones its programmer to ask for advice. And when she tells Robot that the solution is to learn new human dialects and habits, it understands what she wants it to do, downloads the code she sends it, and starts gathering data that will help it fix the shortcomings in its training data.
To an A.I. programmer, this is truly a fairy-tale moment. From a real A.I. today, the programmer might get an error code—if they’re lucky. More likely, a robot in this situation would barge on with bad data, working badly and never knowing it, while accusing its users of “being mean.” Unable to navigate unfamiliar building types, a real-life Robot probably would have ended up lost in a closet like a flying Roomba, sticking to its pre-programmed conversational routines, cheerfully asking a Spock T-shirt if it would please cough into a handkerchief.
Advertisement
A real-life Robot probably would have ended up lost in a closet like a flying
Roomba.
The problem is that today’s A.I.s—and those of the foreseeable future—are very limited in scope. Called artificial narrow intelligence, or ANI, they can perform well on simple tasks, but don’t understand the world around them or what it is they’re really doing. The A.I.s in our science fiction are almost all artificial general intelligence, or AGI, which can perceive the world at or above the level of a human. Robot at first seems like it might be an ANI—it says what it has been programmed to say, and it has a “preference” for its initial route simply because of its internal coordinate system. But all that changes when Robot phones home. An A.I. programmer sees Robot notice the flaws in its training data, understand abstract concepts, and pick up languages on the fly, and she knows from this point forward that Robot is an AGI and is therefore as magical as a talking mirror from a fairy tale.

主要讨论点：关于规则、法规执行以及技术平台控制权的讨论

不同观点：
• [mianos] 提到澳大利亚的“eKaren”事件，其中一名澳大利亚人试图在全球范围内封锁某些内容，但被法院裁定无权这么做。这反映出对跨国界内容控制权的限制，强调个人或单个国家无法在全球范围内行使此类权力。

• [apatheticonion] 支持更多的操作系统竞争，并认为硬件厂商通过控制驱动程序和锁定引导加载程序来限制竞争。他建议欧盟应强制电子设备解锁引导加载程序，并要求厂商公开驱动程序源代码或提供足够文档，以便用户自行支持这些平台。这被视为“维修权”在软件方面的延伸。

• [YetAnotherNick] 对规则中的罚款机制持批评态度，认为过去的罚款在一些奇怪和温和的案例中过于严厉，而在一些更明显的误导性案例中却很少见。他还指出规则的模糊性和缺乏警告的问题，并认为罚款对政府产生不良激励，尤其是当罚款资金控制权在罚款机构手中时。

• [mdhb] 支持严格执行法规和维护国家主权，认为在当前国际政治环境下，自我弱化以避免成为目标的策略已经被证明无效。他强调应毫不犹豫地执行自己的法律和主权。

data.title: A M.2 HDMI capture card
data.author: Venn1
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了Magewell Eco M.2 HDMI采集卡，特别关注其在Linux系统上的使用。由于PCIe插槽逐渐减少，M.2接口成为替代方案。产品包装包含必要的线缆和安装配件。在x86系统上，需下载并安装特定驱动和依赖。对于ARM设备，如NVIDIA Jetson TX1/2，也提供了驱动支持，但在Rockchip 3588上需要一些调试。该卡在OBS等软件中表现良好，支持1080p 60帧的视频捕捉，也可用作WebRTC应用的摄像头。尽管价格较高（385美元），但在eBay上可以较低价格购得。总体评价为6.8分，适合需要稳定M.2采集卡的专业用户。

43755286.article_content:
Capture Cards
Magewell Eco: M.2 HDMI Capture Card
3 days ago
2 comments
2 comments
Cinema Mode
Reddit
LinkedIn
X
Facebook
Have you ever looked at an NVMe drive and thought to yourself, ‘Hey, this would be 31.7% cooler with HDMI ports?’ Yeah, me neither, but I’ve always wanted to see how well (or if) one of these critters works on Linux.
Today is that day.
WHY?
PCIe slots are becoming an endangered species on modern motherboards, and you know what? I get it. Most people just pop in a GPU and call it a day. Fortunately, those extra PCIe lanes tend to get repurposed as additional M.2 holes. Since that’s “just” an x4 connection, why not feed it something other than a storage device?
IN THE BOX
In the box, you get two SHD-to-HDMI Type-A cables, a static-free bag, and the sense that Magewell expects you to figure the rest out.
MOUNTING HARDWARE
To the best of my knowledge exactly one company sells this elusive sliver of metal,
MODDYI
. They come in
full
and
low
profile.
Mounting the SHD-to-HDMI Type-A cables was relatively straightforward, and the Magewell Eco pops in like any other M.2 device.
X86 DRIVERS
Magewell is pretty good about drivers and the Eco series is no exception. The first thing you need to do is head over to the downloads section and grab the latest
Eco Capture Linux x86 Driver
.
Now it’s time to crack ope a terminal and  install some dependencies so we can build the kernel module.
Debian
sudo apt install linux-headers-$(uname -r) make gcc binutils
Fedora
sudo dnf install kernel-devel
Extract the *.gz archive and change into the EcoCaptureForLinuxX86 directory.
tar -xf Eco* ; rm Eco*.gz ; cd Eco*
Run the installer script.
./install.sh
Now you can run the Magewell info utility to verify that everything makes with the working.
sudo mweco-info -l
ARM DRIVERS
Welcome to the “Huh, didn’t expect that to work” section. Magewell offers ARM drivers for the NVIDIA Jetson TX1/2, so I figured they probably wouldn’t work with my Rockchip 3588 SOC, but hey, I’m not one to let logic get in the way of an afternoon of frustration.
Long story short, Armbian with kernel 6.14.0-edge is the winning combination. The ARM drivers compile against the 6.1 vendor kernel, but that’s about all they do.
The first thing you need to do is head over to the downloads section and grab the latest
Eco Capture Linux Driver for Jetson TX2
.
Now it’s time to crack open a terminal and install some dependencies.
sudo apt install make gcc binutils
Install the kernel headers using Armbian Config.
sudo armbian-config
The adventure tree goes: System > Kernel > Install Linux Headers
Extract the *.gz archive and change into the EcoCaptureForLinuxX86 directory.
tar -xf Eco* ; rm Eco*.gz ; cd Eco*
Run the installer script.
./install.sh
Now you can run the Magewell info utility to verify that everything makes with the working.
sudo mweco-info -l
OBS & WEBRTC
The Eco Capture Dual HDMI M.2 shows up like any other V4L2 device in OBS. I didn’t run into any issues while capturing two 1080p 60 streams.
And if you’re wondering, yes, the Eco Capture Dual HDMI M.2 can be used as a webcam in WebRTC apps like Discord, Jitsi, and Zoom.
PIXEL PEEPING
Somewhere around 2010, capturing video from digital sources became a solved problem. In 2025, even a $10 “sh*tbox” HDMI encoder (on the left) looks
alright
serviceable. The Eco Capture Dual HDMI M.2 and Decklink Mini 4K Recorder have identical picture quality and latency, but the Magewell does a decidedly better job at fitting into an M.2 hole – and this is the important bit.
VERDICT
I’ve been using this critter in the studio for the past couple of weeks without so much as a hiccup. That said, at $385 the Eco Capture Dual HDMI M.2 isn’t something you pick up just to play around with. You’re going to need a good reason. Fortunately, that good reason came in the form of finding a gang of new, in-box units on eBay
selling for anywhere between $60 and $100
.

不同观点：
• **[pmags的观点]**：AI社区在生物医学领域越来越像是在兜售“万灵油”（即名不副实）。虽然机器学习/AI非常强大，但诸如“疾病终结”之类的过于乐观的预测可能长期来看弊大于利。这些不切实际的预测可能会误导公众和科研方向。

• **[randcraw的观点]**：
   1. 目前被称为AI的技术大多实际上是机器学习，而机器学习并不创造新知识，只是重新组织已有的信息。
   2. 机器学习尚未能够提出新的科学假设并验证它们。因此，AI目前只是作为技术工具推动技术进步，但并不能像理论那样推动科学进步。

补充讨论：
• **对AI/ML的过度宣传**：randcraw指出，很多人对AI/ML的 hype 没有认识到其局限性，特别是在科学发现方面的局限。在AI能够真正提出并验证科学假设之前，它主要还是一个技术工具。

• **对科学 vs. 技术的影响**：randcraw进一步区分了技术进步和科学理论进步，认为AI目前只能推动前者，而不能像理论那样对科学有深远影响。

争议焦点：
• **AI/ML是否能够带来科学革命**：randcraw认为AI/ML目前不能带来科学革命，而只是技术上的进步；而隐含的另一种观点（可能代表一些AI hype的支持者）则认为AI/ML有可能带来科学上的重大突破。

• **不切实际的预测的影响**：pmags认为不切实际的预测会带来负面影响，而randcraw则进一步分析了这些预测背后技术与科学的区别，指出这些预测可能源于对AI/ML能力的误解或过度期望。

data.title: Find the Odd Disk
data.author: layer8
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一个简单的在线游戏，玩家需要用肉眼找出颜色不同的磁盘。游戏提示玩家关闭屏幕上的蓝光过滤器以确保准确性。游戏以20轮为一轮，结束后邀请玩家再次参与以提供更多数据。文章提供了英文、法文和西班牙文三种语言版本，并在游戏结束后感谢玩家的参与，鼓励重新游玩以收集更多数据。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：色彩感知测试的结果和影响因素

不同观点：
• [noduerme] 认为色彩感知能力可能受到职业背景（如平面设计师）的影响，并提到照明条件对色彩识别的影响，特别是不同光源下的色彩变化。他还质疑屏幕伽马和范围对色彩感知的影响，建议应在相同印刷条件下进行公平测试。
• [lucb1e] 关注测试的算法和实现细节，分享了生成颜色的代码片段，并讨论了测试的难度递增方式以及防止重复挑战的机制。
• [zootboy] 希望有一个“无法分辨”的选项，因为一些困难的挑战更多的是靠运气而非真正的色彩辨别能力。
• [layer8] 引用了ScienceClic YouTube频道的邀请，指出该测试是作为科学实验的一部分。
• [nkrisc] 希望对错误结果进行基本分析，观察是否存在颜色类型的显著性分布，特别是红色错误较多的现象。
• [tripdout] 提到屏幕校准和色彩准确性可能影响测试结果，特别是在便宜的显示器上，某些色调可能看起来相同。

补充讨论：
• [js2] 提到了X-Rite色彩挑战和色相测试，这是一个用于了解色觉敏锐度的工具。
• [blueflow] 质疑结果在多大程度上取决于视觉准确性，多大程度上取决于显示器。
• [nuancebydefault] 分享了关于亮度和颜色感知的视觉现象，并提到眼偏头痛的经历。
• [susam] 分享了自己的高分结果，并提到始终启用Night Shift模式，不确定这对测试的影响。
• [fallinghawks] 获得了19/20的分数，提到长时间观察色块会导致颜色偏移的感知，建议间歇观察以提高辨别力。
• [havan_agrawal] 建议加入“控制”挑战，即三个色块相同的情况，以检测潜在的偏见。
• [Night_Thastus] 指出显示器类型、屏幕光泽度、室内照明等硬件因素对测试结果的影响。
• [wrs] 认为在后期挑战中，色块的后像效应可能比实际色差更大，影响了判断。
• [ryao] 在iPad Pro上完成了测试，认为最后几个色块无法区分，显示器的色彩准确性是关键因素。

争议焦点：
• 测试结果在多大程度上反映了真实的色彩感知能力，还是更多地受到显示器质量和设置的影响。
• 是否需要加入控制挑战以排除偏见，以及测试算法本身的公平性和透明度。

data.title: From 'catch up' to 'catch us': How Google took the lead in enterprise AI
data.author: sh_tomer
data.article_summary: 一年前，谷歌在企业AI领域的表现一度被认为落后于OpenAI、Anthropic和微软。尽管谷歌发明了Transformer等核心技术，但其在企业AI竞赛中显得被动。然而，在最近的Google Cloud Next 2025大会上，谷歌展示出强大的自信和转变，推出了领先的AI模型、强大的基础设施和一致的企业战略，宣告其在企业AI领域的逆袭。谷歌利用过去一年进行深度执行，将其技术资产转化为高性能、集成平台，迅速赢得企业决策者的青睐。从运行在高效定制芯片上的全球最强AI模型，到针对现实商业问题的AI代理生态系统，谷歌展示了其在基础设施和模型整合上的优势，使其在企业AI革命中处于领先地位。尽管过去曾有失误和质疑，但谷歌通过内部改革和领导层的决心，实现了从追赶到领先的转变。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：谷歌的领先地位是否主要依赖于营销，还是其技术实力使然。部分人认为媒体报道和宣传夸大了谷歌的实际优势，而另一部分人则认为这些报道是基于谷歌真实的创新和市场表现。
• 相关例子：提到“很多文章”显示出谷歌的领先地位，这可能是媒体影响的结果，但也可能是基于谷歌在多个领域的实际突破和市场占有率。

Just a year ago, the narrative around
Google
and enterprise AI felt stuck. Despite inventing core technologies like the Transformer, the tech giant seemed perpetually on the back foot, overshadowed by
OpenAI
‘s viral success,
Anthropic
‘s coding prowess and
Microsoft
‘s aggressive enterprise push.
But witness the scene at
Google Cloud Next 2025
in Las Vegas last week: A confident Google, armed with benchmark-topping models, formidable infrastructure and a cohesive enterprise strategy, declaring a stunning turnaround. In a closed-door analyst meeting with senior Google executives, one analyst summed it up. This feels like the moment, he said, when Google went from “catch up, to catch us.”
This sentiment that Google has not only caught up with but even surged ahead of OpenAI and Microsoft in the enterprise AI race prevailed throughout the event. And it’s more than just Google’s marketing spin. Evidence suggests Google has leveraged the past year for intense, focused execution, translating its technological assets into a performant, integrated platform that’s rapidly winning over enterprise decision-makers. From boasting the world’s most powerful AI models running on hyper-efficient custom silicon, to a burgeoning ecosystem of AI agents designed for real-world business problems, Google is making a compelling case that it was never actually lost – but that its stumbles masked a period of deep, foundational development.
Now, with its integrated stack firing on all cylinders, Google appears positioned to lead the next phase of the enterprise AI revolution. And in my interviews with several Google executives at Next, they said Google wields advantages in infrastructure and model integration that competitors like OpenAI, Microsoft or AWS will struggle to replicate.
The shadow of doubt: acknowledging the recent past
It’s impossible to appreciate the current momentum without acknowledging the recent past. Google was the birthplace of the Transformer architecture, which sparked the modern revolution in large language models (LLMs). Google also started investing in specialized AI hardware (TPUs), which are now driving industry-leading efficiency, a decade ago. And yet, two and a half years ago, it inexplicably found itself playing defense.
OpenAI’s ChatGPT captured the public imagination and enterprise interest at
breathtaking speed
and became the fastest-growing app in history. Competitors like Anthropic carved out niches in areas like coding.
Google’s own public steps sometimes seemed tentative or flawed. The infamous Bard
demo fumbles
in 2023
and the later controversy over its image generator
producing historically inaccurate depictions
fed a narrative of a company potentially hampered by internal bureaucracy or overcorrection on alignment. It felt like Google was lost: The AI stumbles seemed to fit a pattern, first shown by Google’s initial slowness in the cloud competition, where it remained a distant third in market share behind Amazon and Microsoft. Google Cloud CTO Will Grannis acknowledged the early questions about whether Google Cloud would stand behind in the long run. “Is it even a real thing?,” he recalled people asking him. The question lingered: Could Google translate its undeniable research brilliance and infrastructure scale into enterprise AI dominance?
The pivot: a conscious decision to lead
Behind the scenes, however, a shift was underway, catalyzed by a conscious decision at the highest levels to reclaim leadership. Mat Velloso, VP of product for Google DeepMind’s AI Developer Platform, described sensing a pivotal moment upon joining Google in Feb. 2024, after leaving Microsoft. “When I came to Google, I spoke with Sundar [Pichai], I spoke with several leaders here, and I felt like that was the moment where they were deciding, okay, this [generative AI] is a thing the industry clearly cares about. Let’s make it happen,” Velloso shared in an interview with VentureBeat during Next last week.
This renewed push wasn’t hampered by a feared “brain drain” that some outsiders felt was depleting Google. In fact, the company quietly doubled down on execution in early 2024 – a year marked by aggressive hiring, internal unification and customer traction. While competitors made splashy hires, Google retained its core AI leadership, including DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis and Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian, providing stability and deep expertise.
Moreover, talent began flowing towards Google’s focused mission. Logan Kilpatrick, for instance, returned to Google from OpenAI, drawn by the opportunity to build foundational AI within the company, creating it. data.title: Christianity was always for the poor (2024)
data.author: YeGoblynQueenne
data.article_summary: 《Progress》期刊春季版发布，现可订阅印刷版。本期包含多篇文章：Shawn Fain讨论工人应获得更多个人时间；Brent Cebul和Lily Geismer分析拜登政策的失败；Isabella Weber探讨通货膨胀对政府的影响；Jared Abbott则聚焦工人阶级的变化。此外，文章还通过进化生物学类比，指出人类历史和制度常被赋予过于“本质化”的期望，而基督教自起源以来也经历了诸多演变，不同教派有着显著差异。特别是，新约实际上将个人财富视为内在的恶，而非仅是痴迷于财富的问题。这些文章挑战了人们对历史和宗教的常见假设。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：基督教与财富的关系，以及如何在不同历史和现代背景下解读基督教教义。

• louison11认为，早期基督教教义反对财富，因为当时的财富往往来自土地掠夺、税收 farming 和债务奴役。然而，现代社会的情况不同，投资和财富积累可以是出于爱和保护的行为，而不是贪婪。他强调理解圣经需要结合其历史背景，而不是简单地套用现代价值观。

• teleforce引用了历史事件，指出在基督教早期，追随者多为贫穷和弱势群体，这与先知们的经历相似。这一观点支持了基督教最初是作为被压迫者的运动而存在的看法。

• ivape补充说，基督教最早是在贫穷和受迫害的人群中传播的，并且提到耶稣在圣殿中驱赶商人的行为，进一步说明基督教早期对商业行为的批判态度。

• skybrian补充说，当基督教成为罗马帝国国教后，情况变得复杂，拥有国家权力的基督徒在宗教宽容尚未发明的时候，导致了政治纠纷和复杂的历史发展。

• 争议的焦点在于基督教教义中关于财富的教导如何在不同历史背景下解读。早期基督教对财富的批判态度是否适用于现代社会，以及基督教是否本质上与政治和经济权力相关。

Shawn Fain: Workers Deserve More Time for Themselves
Shawn Fain
Why Bidenism Failed
Brent Cebul
Lily Geismer
Inflation Kills Governments
Isabella Weber
The Working Class Has Left the Building
Jared Abbott
In evolutionary biology, one of those mysterious thresholds of which at present we have only the vaguest conceptual grasp is that moment in the ramification of any phylogenic series at which an irrevocable taxonomic divergence occurs, and a genuinely new species emerges. Traces of the event linger on in the paleontological record and the sequences of the genome, of course, but only in a fragmentary way. Only at the end of the process can we say with some assurance that a cow is most definitely not a whale, and that neither (to its credit) is a corporate attorney. But, of course, we expect nature to be capricious, and since the time of Darwin especially we have learned to find it unsurprising that horses and snails should have arisen out of precursors that did not even dimly adumbrate what horses and snails would eventually be.
Our expectations of human history, however, tend to be somewhat more “essentialist” than that, principally because our institutions and orders of power constantly rewrite the past to establish their own pedigrees. Most of us are able to inhabit and find shelter in cultural, social, political, and religious structures precisely because we trust in their unity, stability, and constancy over time. And even those of us who are anything but Hegelians are likely to believe that there is some kind of rational consistency to history’s disclosure of human possibilities, and that we can explain how the Renaissance sprang from the late Middle Ages with something like the same precision with which we can explain the course of a river reaching the sea. The result of thinking that way, though, can be fairly fantastic, rather like working on the assumption that whales, cows, and corporate attorneys constitute a single species.
All of which is a very circuitous way of saying that there is not, and has never been, a single identifiable thing that we can call “Christianity” except with excruciating generality. From the very first, “the Way” (as it was originally known among its adherents) was like a kind of pluripotential genetic code waiting to be developed by epigenetic forces; and down the centuries, its expressions continuously evolved and diverged into countless unanticipated and ultimately incommiscible breeds. This is not to say that the original “genetic” impulse was random, incidentally; I happen to believe, for instance, that the first followers of Jesus of Nazareth truly did have real experiences of him as alive again after his crucifixion, and that that is why their movement did not dissolve upon his death (though this is not the place to argue the point). It is only to say that there are many religious phenomena out there — such as the great mainstream of American white Evangelicalism — to which we apply the word “Christianity” about as meaningfully as we might apply the word “dinosaur” to a sparrow (there have, you see, been a few developments since those days).
Most modern (and especially most American) Christians are quite accustomed, for instance, to thinking of Christianity as a fairly commonsensical creed as regards the practicalities of life. On the matter of wealth, they take it as given that, while the New Testament enjoins generosity to the poor, it otherwise allows the wealthy to enjoy the fruits of their industry or fair fortune with a clean conscience. Common sense tells them that it is not wealth as such that the New Testament condemns, but only a spiritually unhealthy preoccupation with it — the idolatry of riches, wealth misused, wealth immorally gained; riches in and of themselves, surely, are neither good nor bad. But in fact, one thing in startlingly short supply in the New Testament is common sense, and the commonsensical view of the early church is invariably the wrong one. In point of fact, the New Testament, alarmingly enough, condemns personal wealth not merely as a moral danger, but as an
intrinsic
evil. Actually, the texts are so unambiguous on this matter that it requires an almost heroic defiance of the obvious to fail to grasp their import. Admittedly, many translations down the centuries have had an emollient effect on a few of the New Testament’s severer pronouncements. But this is an old story.
Jesus condemned not only an unhealthy preoccupation with riches, but the getting and keeping of riches as such.
Take, for example, the word used in Christian scripture for one of the principal virtues of the new movement: κοινωνία, or
koinōnia
. The standard translations of the term are usually something along the lines of “fellowship” or even “community,” but a more accurate rendering
43745088.article_summary: 《Progress》期刊春季版发布，现可订阅印刷版。本期包含多篇文章：Shawn Fain讨论工人应获得更多个人时间；Brent Cebul和Lily Geismer分析拜登政策的失败；Isabella Weber探讨通货膨胀对政府的影响；Jared Abbott则聚焦工人阶级的变化。此外，文章还通过进化生物学类比，指出人类历史和制度常被赋予过于“本质化”的期望，而基督教自起源以来也经历了诸多演变，不同教派有着显著差异。特别是，新约实际上将个人财富视为内在的恶，而非仅是痴迷于财富的问题。这些文章挑战了人们对历史和宗教的常见假设。

data.title: First hormone-free male birth control pill enters human trials
data.author: Teever
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：新型男性避孕药YCT-529的安全性、有效性及相关机制的讨论

不同观点：
• **对药物长期安全性的担忧**：[thecupisblue] 和 [w10-1] 对YCT-529长期使用的安全性提出质疑。[thecupisblue] 担心长期抑制RARα受体会导致其他RAR受体（如RARβ和γ）代偿，可能引发副作用，尤其是RARα在细胞发育和凋亡中的作用与某些癌症有关。[w10-1] 进一步指出，RARα途径在血细胞发育和凋亡中起到重要作用，长期使用可能会带来不确定的风险，甚至影响后代。

• **与其他非激素男性避孕方法的比较**：[johnisgood] 提到现有的非激素男性避孕药，如α-受体阻滞剂（例如Silodosin），也能达到90-99%的避孕效果，且不会影响性欲，停药后立即可逆。他暗示这种方法可能比YCT-529更成熟，建议大家尝试和比较。

• **热力避孕法**：[Voultapher] 提出目前已有基于热力的非激素男性避孕方法，尽管不广为人知，但有科学支持。他提到1930年代在印度进行的长期研究显示该方法没有长期副作用，并表示可以提供更多研究链接。

• **对99%有效性的质疑**：[hwpythonner] 和 [pftburger] 对YCT-529的99%有效性提出实际使用中的质疑。[hwpythonner] 询问是否包含不按时服药的情况，而[pftburger] 则指出99%的有效性意味着每年仍可能有三个意外怀孕的案例。

• **对药物其他功能的幽默或讽刺评论**：[khazhoux] 开玩笑地提到，发明一种消除男性不应期的药物将带来巨大财富，而[panny] 则讽刺地表示担心这种药物会被添加到公共水 supply 中。[anonym29] 则用讽刺的语气表示，这种避孕方法是否会像其他流行文化现象一样被追捧。

补充讨论：
• **对讨论质量的关注**：[thecupisblue] 在一开始提到，这个话题下的许多评论更像是为了获取点赞（"karma farming"），而不是为了深入讨论，呼吁大家更认真地参与讨论。

• **对科学进展的积极评价**：[Ericson2314] 对YCT-529的研发表示惊喜和乐观，认为这是科学资助的成果，并希望这能促使更多人对科学研究进行反思和支持。

争议焦点：YCT-529的长期安全性及其与其他非激素避孕方法的比较是讨论中的主要争议点。部分评论者对其有效性和实际应用中的可行性提出质疑，而另一些评论者则关注其潜在的副作用和风险。

data.article_summary: 《Business Insider》专注于讲述创新故事，涵盖商业、科技、娱乐、健康等多个领域。它通过深入分析和独家报道，揭示影响全球市场的重要趋势和新兴企业。文章通常以简洁、易懂的方式呈现，满足读者对快速变化的商业环境的好奇心和学习需求。此外，该平台还关注知名企业家和领导者的成功秘诀，为希望了解行业动态和创新实践的读者提供有价值的见解。《Business Insider》凭借其多样化内容和及时性，成为获取全球创新故事的重要来源。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：企业应如何分配资源以促进增长，尤其是在AI领域的发展

不同观点：
• [_aavaa_] 的观点：应精简产品线，放弃低增长产品，将研发资源重新分配到人工智能（AI）领域。这种策略的目的是集中资源推动高增长领域的创新，即使这意味着继续推动可能已经过热的投资领域（暗示"pumping that bubble"）。

• [toomuchtodo] 的观点：未直接发表评论，但通过分享存档链接，可能暗示读者参考外部信息以获取更多背景或数据支持。这可能意味着对快速将资源全部集中在AI领域持保留态度，建议在做出重大战略调整前应参考更广泛的信息和数据。

补充讨论：
- [_aavaa_] 强调了资源再分配的紧迫性，尤其是增加对AI的投资，认为这是推动增长的关键。
- [toomuchtodo] 的回应则更侧重于信息和数据的参考，可能暗示对快速追逐AI投资热潮的谨慎态度。争议的焦点在于是否应集中资源全力投资于AI，还是采取更平衡和谨慎的策略。

data.title: Raspberry Pi Lidar Scanner
data.author: Venn1
data.article_summary: PiLiDAR是一个DIY项目，旨在创建一个360°的3D全景扫描仪。该项目使用LDRobot的LiDAR传感器（如LD06、LD19或STL27L）进行扫描，结合Raspberry Pi和HQ Camera进行全景照片拍摄。系统通过自定义串行驱动程序和CRC校验确保数据完整性，并支持2D实时可视化和导出。全景图使用Hugin软件拼接，3D场景通过Open3D进行可视化和导出，支持多种格式。硬件方面，项目使用Raspberry Pi 4、NEMA17步进电机和A4988驱动器，供电可选择18650电池或USB电源银行。项目还涉及GPIO中断处理、I2C配置和UART设置等技术细节，以实现完整的扫描和数据处理流程。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LIDAR技术及其应用、成本估算、精度和实用性、软件后处理、技术挑战与安全性

不同观点：
• **成本透明性与估算**：godelski建议在硬件产品中提供材料清单和成本估算链接，认为即使是大致数字也能帮助人们决定是否自行尝试，并强调文档记录对节省时间的重要性。他还提供了一些具体部件的成本估算例子。
• **LIDAR的应用范围**：Animats指出，这类LIDAR的最大范围约为12米，适用于小型机器人和辅助传感器，但长距离LIDAR仍然难以实现。
• **高精度距离测量**：amelius寻求一种廉价的方法来测量约300毫米距离上的约10微米的精度，询问是否有相关解决方案。
• **技术进步的感慨**：abraae感叹现代技术使个人能够创造出令人难以置信的技术，尽管有些"旧时代"的东西更好。

补充讨论：
• **3D空间操作体验**：politelemon赞赏Sketchfab的3D空间示例，但对鼠标控制的混乱表示困惑。
• **数据精度与应用场景**：joeevans1000询问LIDAR的精度和数据，特别是超过10米的应用，并提到不同市场对扫描仪的需求（精度 vs 内容创作）。
• **LIDAR的软件后处理**：heljara对LIDAR在室内扫描中的应用表示兴趣，并询问软件后处理、点云合并、遮挡问题、多房间扫描等细节。
• **技术扩展性与性能**：badmonster询问PiLiDAR在户外大规模数据集上的性能表现，是否能适用于如SemanticKITTI或nuScenes等数据集。
• **商业使用与贡献**：joeevans1000关注PiLiDAR的商业使用权，询问贡献要求和方式。
• **IMU选择问题**：Aspos质疑使用GY-521和MPU6050作为IMU的选择，并询问其在设置中的具体作用。
• **传感器安全性**：Havoc关注LIDAR传感器的安全性，特别是对眼睛的影响。
• **LIDAR干扰问题**：mannyv提出如何避免自己的LIDAR干扰他人的LIDAR的问题。

争议焦点：
• **LIDAR的成本与应用价值**：一些人认为成本透明性和大致估算有助于决策，但具体应用中的精度和性能表现（如heljara与joeevans1000的讨论）可能影响其价值判断。
• **技术选择与实用性**：Aspos对IMU选择提出质疑，反映出对具体技术实现细节的不同看法。

这些观点展示了LIDAR技术在不同应用场景中的潜力和挑战，以及成本、精度、软件支持等方面的多维度考量。

Setup
Power Button (Wakeup & Shutdown)
Wakeup is hardwired to Pin 3
enable gpio-shutdown
echo "dtoverlay=gpio-shutdown" >> /boot/firmware/config.txt
if necesessary:
sudo nano /etc/systemd/logind.conf
HandlePowerKey=poweroff
enable i2c-GPIO for GY-521 Accelerometer
GY-521 (MPU 6060): Accelerometer, Gyroscope and thermometer
i2c adress: 0x68
Since GPIO3 is hardwired to the Power Button, we need to use i2c-GPIO to map custom i2c pins (
tutorial
). Unlike serial is not getting crossed, so we connect SDA-SDA and SCL-SCL.
SDA: GPIO22
SCL: GPIO27
disable ic2_arm and enable i2c-gpio in /boot/firmware/config.txt
dtparam=i2c_arm=off
dtoverlay=i2c-gpio,bus=3,i2c_gpio_delay_us=1,i2c_gpio_sda=22,i2c_gpio_scl=27
search for devices on i2c bus 3:
sudo i2cdetect -y 3
Power LED and CPU fan
# CPU fan at lower temp
echo "dtoverlay=gpio-fan,gpiopin=4,temp=45000" >> /boot/firmware/config.txt
# Power LED Heartbeat:
echo "dtparam=pwr_led_trigger=timer" >> /boot/firmware/config.txt
Scan Button: register GPIO interrupt
make script executable:
chmod +x gpio_interrupt.py
create new service for autostart
sudo nano /etc/systemd/system/pilidar.service
content:
[Unit]
Description=PiLiDAR-Button
After=network.target
[Service]
Type=simple
User=pi
Environment=LG_WD=/tmp
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /home/pi/PiLiDAR/gpio_interrupt.py
Restart=no
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
reload daemon, enable and start service:
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable pilidar.service
sudo systemctl start pilidar.service
check service if necessary:
sudo systemctl status pilidar.service
set Permission for UART on Raspberry Pi
temporary solution:
sudo chmod a+rw /dev/ttyS0
old solution: make it permanent by disabling password for chmod:
sudo visudo
pi ALL=(ALL:ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/chmod a+rw /dev/ttyS0
then execute the
temporary
solution from python:
import subprocess
command = "sudo chmod a+rw /dev/ttyS0"
process = subprocess.P

data.title: Let's give PRO/VENIX a barely adequate, pre-C89 TCP/IP stack, featuring Slirp-CK
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary:
本文讲述了作者多年前计划为Commodore 64编写TCP/IP协议栈，但未付诸实践。与此同时，其他人成功实现了这一目标。作者曾购买TCP/IP Illustrated书籍，但一直未拆封。如今，借助AI和更多现代文档，作者成功为DEC Professional 380运行的PRO/VENIX系统开发了一个简易网络栈，通过SLIP和Crypto Ancienne代理实现对现代互联网的访问，并成功在真实硬件上加载Google主页。

文章还回顾了DEC Professional系列电脑的历史。DEC最初计划将Professional系列作为桌面办公电脑推出，避免与PDP-11小型计算机竞争，但因软件延迟发布而失败。随后，DEC改变策略，将Professional系列作为PDP-11桌面电脑销售，并移植了多个操作系统，包括基于V7和System V的PRO/VENIX。最终，DEC选择VenturCom的Venix作为官方Unix选项，而非自行开发的Ultrix-11，因为后者在性能上遇到问题。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：在老旧计算机上实现网络协议的可行性及相关项目

不同观点：
• [trollbridge] 认为在老旧的PC上实现完整的网络协议栈（如SLIP、TCP/IP、SMTP、POP3）非常困难，尤其是在性能有限、内存受限的设备上。他通过自身经历说明了在PC BASIC环境下实现这些协议的挑战，包括字符丢失、计算校验和的困难以及内存限制等问题。尽管存在这些问题，他最终还是成功实现了基本功能。

• [jrdres] 指出将TCP/IP协议引入老旧机器是一个正在流行的趋势，并提到了一些现有的项目，如M Brutman的"mTCP"驱动和DogCow的"Sabina"网络套件，这些项目旨在为8088 PC和原始的128K Macintosh提供网络功能。他提到这些项目进展缓慢，部分原因是开发者的日常工作影响。

补充讨论：
• [pjmlp] 简短评论，认为这是一个有趣的历史片段，但没有深入讨论技术细节或表达明确立场。

争议焦点：
• 实现老旧计算机上的网络协议栈的可行性及其实际应用价值。 [trollbridge] 强调了技术挑战和实际困难，而 [jrdres] 则指出现有项目和趋势，表明这种努力是有价值且可行的。

43741849.article_content:
I had this grand idea many moons ago about writing up a TCP/IP stack for the Commodore 64, along with a lot of other people, and several of those people eventually did so before I even wrote a single opcode of 6502 assembly. For that purpose I had bought the box set of
TCP/IP Illustrated
(what would now be called the first edition prior to the 2011 update) for a hundred-odd bucks on sale which has now sat on my bookshelf, encased in its original shrinkwrap, for at least twenty years. It would be fun to put up the 4.4BSD data structures poster it came with but that would require opening it.
Fortunately, today
we have AI
we have many more excellent and comprehensive documents on the subject, and more importantly, we've recently brought back up an oddball platform that doesn't have networking either: our DEC Professional 380 running the System V-based PRO/VENIX V2.0, which you met
a couple articles back
. The DEC Professionals are a notoriously incompatible member of the PDP-11 family and, short of DECnet (DECNA) support in its unique Professional Operating System, there's officially no other way you can get one on a network — let alone the modern Internet. Are we going to let that stop us?
Of course not! Here's our barebones network stack for PRO/VENIX, the Pro's only official Unix option, downloading the Google home page on real hardware (internal addresses bleeped out) over SLIP and a
Crypto Ancienne
proxy for TLS 1.3. And, as we'll discuss, if you can get
this
thing on the network, you can get almost
anything
on the network! Easily portable and painfully verbose source code is included.
Recall from our lengthy history of
DEC's early misadventures with personal computers
that, in Digital's ill-advised plan to avoid the DEC Pros cannibalizing low-end sales from their categorical PDP-11 minicomputers, Digital's Small Systems Group deliberately made the DEC Professional series nearly totally incompatible despite the fact they used the same CPUs. In their initial roll-out strategy in 1982, the Pros (as well as their sibling systems, the Rainbow and the DECmate II) were only supposed to be mere desktop office computers — the fact the Pros were PDP-11s internally was mostly treated as an implementation detail. The idea backfired spectacularly against the IBM PC when the Pros and their promised office software failed to arrive on time and in 1984 DEC retooled around a new concept of explicitly selling the Pros as desktop PDP-11s. This required porting operating systems that PDP-11 minis typically ran: RSX-11M Plus was already there as the low-level layer of the Professional Operating System (P/OS), and DEC internally ported RT-11 (as PRO/RT-11) and COS.
PDP-11s were also famous for running Unix and so DEC needed a Unix for the Pro as well, though eventually only one official option was ever available: a port of VenturCom's Venix based on V7 Unix and later System V Release 2.0 called PRO/VENIX. After the
last article
, I had the distinct pleasure of being contacted by Paul Kleppner, the company's first paid employee in 1981, who was part of the group at VenturCom that did the Pro port and stayed at the company until 1988. Venix was originally developed from V6 Unix on the PDP-11/23 incorporating Myron Zimmerman's real-time extensions to the kernel (such as semaphores and asynchronous I/O), then a postdoc in physics at MIT; Kleppner's father was the professor of the lab Zimmerman worked in. Zimmerman founded VenturCom in 1981 to capitalize on the emerging Unix market, becoming one of the earliest commercial Unix licensees. Venix-11 was subsequently based on the later V7 Unix, as was Venix/86, which was the first Unix on the IBM PC in January 1983 and was ported to the DEC Rainbow as Venix/86R. In addition to its real-time extensions and enhanced segmentation capability, critical for memory management in smaller 16-bit address spaces, it also included a full desktop graphics package.
Notably, DEC themselves were also a Unix licensee through their Unix Engineering Group and already had an enhanced V7 Unix of their own running on the PDP-11, branded initially as V7M. Subsequently the UEG developed a port of 4.2BSD with some System V components for the VAX and planned to release it as Ultrix-32, simultaneously retconning V7M as Ultrix-11 even though it had little in common with the VAX release. Paul recalls that DEC did attempt a port of Ultrix-11 to the Pro 350 themselves but ran into intractable performance problems. 本文讲述了作者多年前计划为Commodore 64编写TCP/IP协议栈，但未付诸实践。与此同时，其他人成功实现了这一目标。作者曾购买TCP/IP Illustrated书籍，但一直未拆封。如今，借助AI和更多现代文档，作者成功为DEC Professional 380运行的PRO/VENIX系统开发了一个简易网络栈，通过SLIP和Crypto Ancienne代理实现对现代互联网的访问，并成功在真实硬件上加载Google主页。

文章还回顾了DEC Professional系列电脑的历史。DEC最初计划将Professional系列作为桌面办公电脑推出，避免与PDP-11小型计算机竞争，但因软件延迟发布而失败。随后，DEC改变策略，将Professional系列作为PDP-11桌面电脑销售，并移植了多个操作系统，包括基于V7和System V的PRO/VENIX。最终，DEC选择VenturCom的Venix作为官方Unix选项，而非自行开发的Ultrix-11，因为后者在性能上遇到问题。

data.author: shakna
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一个使用SWI Prolog编写的文字冒险游戏（Prolog-Adventure-game）。玩家需要在城堡中找到隐藏的 treasure（ treasure）才能获胜，共有3条生命。游戏包含互动机制，例如锁着的门、隐藏的物品、未完全展示的物体、有限资源以及 inventory（背包）管理。游戏代码存储在treasure_hunt.pl文件中，并附有使用说明（README.md）和游戏记录（transcript.txt）。

data.title: 'Immediate red flags': questions raised over 'expert' much quoted in UK press
data.author: mellosouls
data.article_summary: 多家新闻机构，包括拥有《镜报》、《快报》和《星报》的Reach集团，正在撤下一位自称“心理学家和性咨询师”的芭芭拉·桑蒂尼（Barbara Santini）的相关报道。过去几年中，桑蒂尼被广泛引用，就疫情心理影响、维生素D重要性等话题发表看法。然而，她的资质受到质疑，英国心理学会（BPS）表示她并非其会员。调查显示，桑蒂尼的主要在线身份是性玩具网站Peaches and Screams的顾问，且其“牛津大学”背景无法验证。新闻机构如《每日星报》、《每日镜报》、《卫报》、BBC等已撤下她的评论。此事引发了对AI时代新闻来源验证的关注，一些平台开始改进专家验证机制。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：新闻媒体如何验证专家来源及其资质，尤其是在人工智能时代背景下，虚假信息和冒名专家的问题。

不同观点：
• **对文章中专家资质质疑的观点**：
  - [sublimefire] 指出文章中提到的专家资质存疑，尤其是其与牛津大学和英国心理学会的关系无法验证，可能有人冒充专业人士。
  - [duxup] 提到该‘专家’在商业性网站和Medium上有内容，但缺乏其他公开存在，可能是通过专家与记者连接服务被找到的。

• **关于人工智能影响的讨论**：
  - [ChrisMarshallNY] 认为，人工智能将使得这种冒名顶替变得更加容易，且更难检测，记者有责任验证信息来源，但营销部门通常会编写夸大其词的内容。
  - [bethekidyouwant] 则反驳，认为这与人工智能无关，只是人们在文章中喜欢加上“AI”这个词。

• **对新闻媒体质量和可信度的批判**：
  - [ern] 提到，许多媒体（如Vogue、Metro、Cosmopolitan等）质量较低，读者应该批判性地看待新闻来源，而不是盲目相信。
  - [averageRoyalty] 引用Charlie Beckett的话，认为记者为了追求速度而缺乏严谨性，并暗示一些记者可能使用第三方服务撰写文章或寻找题材。

• **关于公关和广告影响的讨论**：
  - [greatgib] 指出，许多公关公司暗中推动广告，以贡献者身份在媒体上发布软文。
  - [h4ck_th3_pl4n3t] 提供了一个具体例子，质疑某网站上的专家团队的可信度。

• **对记者验证过程的批评**：
  - [mightyham] 强调，背景调查并不困难，专业背景调查服务在招聘过程中很常见，质疑这些记者和媒体为何缺乏验证内容的严谨性。

• **关于系统性问题和防范措施的讨论**：
  - [akoboldfrying] 将此视为一种供应链攻击，认为在没有完全透明度的系统中，这种现象非常普遍，主要依靠声誉损害威胁来防范。
  - [jeffbee] 提到另一个例子Oren Cass，质疑其在《纽约时报》上作为“经济学家”的身份资格。

补充讨论：
• **幽默和讽刺**：
  - [rurp] 对文章中对专家的描述感到好笑，称其为“用微弱的赞美来贬低”。
  - [fallinghawks] 引用网络名言“在网上没有人知道你是一条狗”，讽刺网络身份验证的困难。
  - [keyle] 以讽刺的口吻评论《每日邮报》上几乎所有人都是假专家。

争议焦点：
• 新闻记者在选择专家来源时是否足够严谨，尤其是在人工智能可能加剧冒名顶替现象的时代。
• 人工智能在这一问题中的实际影响，一些人认为人工智能使得冒名顶替更容易，而另一些人认为这是记者本身的懒惰和缺乏验证所致。

Reach, which owns the Mirror, Express and Star, is among the news outlets removing Barbara Santini from its coverage,

National newspapers
‘Immediate red flags’: questions raised over ‘expert’ much quoted in UK press
News outlets pull articles featuring ‘psychologist and sex adviser’ Barbara Santini amid doubts over her credentials
Michael Savage
Media editor
Sat 19 Apr 2025 04.14 EDT
Share
Over the past couple of years, the Oxford-educated psychologist Barbara Santini has been widely quoted as an expert. She has contributed thoughts on everything from the psychological impact of the Covid pandemic to the importance of vitamin D and how playing darts can improve your health.
However, her pronouncements have begun to disappear from articles after concerns that Santini may not be all that she appears. Major news outlets have removed entire articles featuring Santini, or comments made by her, after a series of questions were raised over her qualifications – and even whether her entire identity could be an elaborate hoax.
The case has been described as a wake-up call for newsrooms, as AI tools make it far easier for bad actors to invent supposed experts for their own purposes. Santini’s output has been prolific, with comments in Vogue, Metro, Cosmopolitan, the i newspaper, the Express, Hello!, the Telegraph, the Daily Star, the Daily Mail and the Sun in recent years. She was also quoted in an article for the BBC’s international site, BBC.com.
On closer inspection, her main online presence is as a sex and relationships adviser at an online sex toy outlet, Peaches and Screams. Some of the articles featuring her include a link to the store. Her qualifications are described there as “psychologist and sex adviser – University of Oxford”. However, the British Psychological Society (BPS) said she was not one of its members. She does not appear to have social media profiles, though she has two followers on the blogging site Medium.
Questions over Santini were first raised by the Press Gazette. Peaches and Screams did not respond to repeated requests for comment. The Guardian made several attempts to reach her through a number understood to be connected to her, asking for a meeting or conference call to confirm her identity as well as verification of her qualifications. A message was eventually received stating: “Thank you for your interest in this matter.” No further verification was provided.
Some of the reporters who have quoted her said they received comments through companies that connect journalists with experts. Some cited one such service, ResponseSource. The company has now launched an investigation and suspended the PR agency that handled Santini, and is planning a peer review system that allows journalists to rate an expert they have featured.
Santini also briefly featured on Qwoted, another platform connecting experts to journalists. Shelby Bridges, its director of user success, said the profile was removed after it found “immediate red flags pertaining to credentials and where the account was being accessed from”. She added: “Due to our inability to fully validate her credentials, we disabled the account shortly after it was created.”
Reach, which owns the Daily Mirror, Daily Express and Daily Star, is among the news outlets removing Santini from its coverage. This includes a Daily Star article in which Santini talked about how darts improved qualities such as “planning, foresight and problem-solving”.
Also removed was a Daily Mirror story in which Santini said the Covid pandemic had left some people with “difficulties establishing new relationships, heightened irritability, or a tendency to avoid social situations entirely”. The Guardian has removed her comments from an advertising feature on its website.
The BBC has removed her comments from a piece about AI by BBC Future, commissioned by BBC.com. A BBC spokesperson said: “As a widely used commentator, Barbara Santini’s quotes were used in good faith by BBC Future. While the substance of the article remains valid and her contribution was minor, given we have been unable to confirm Santini’s credentials, we have removed her quotes from the piece.”
The Independent has removed several stories that featured Santini commenting on subjects such as the differences between abuse and BDSM, as well as the importance of vitamin D. Yahoo has removed Santini’s quotes from articles, adding the clarification: “An earlier version of this story included information from a source whose expertise may not be valid. The quotes from the source have been removed.”
While the details of Santini’s case remain unclear, it has raised the issue of how journalists verify the credentials of sources in the AI age. Charlie Beckett, the leader of the journalism and AI project at the London School of Econ

data.author: ingve
data.article_summary:
本文讨论了如何在Go语言中实现手动内存管理，尽管Go具有垃圾回收机制（GC）。作者通过构建一个无类型的、由GC管理的**arena**数据结构，展示了如何在纯Go中进行内存分配而不依赖runtime包。Go的设计避免了未定义行为（Undefined Behavior），并且GC的语义相对简单，使得这种操作成为可能。

作者首先解释了Go中`append`函数的工作原理，它通过指数增长动态数组来减少内存分配次数。而arena则是一种更通用的内存分配策略，它通过分配固定大小的内存块来提高效率。

文中展示了一个简单的内存分配器接口，并讨论了如何为其添加类型安全。然而，Go的GC还需要额外的类型信息，这带来了挑战。作者提醒读者，Go中的自定义分配器可能导致“使用已释放内存”的问题，因为GC在回收时无法识别自定义分配的内存。

总结来说，文章通过具体代码示例，探索了如何在Go中巧妙地绕过GC限制，实现高效的内存管理。

Cheating the Reaper in Go
Even though I am a C++ programmer at heart, Go fascinates me for none of the reasons you think. Go has made several interesting design decisions:
It has virtually no Undefined Behavior
1
.
It has very simple GC semantics that they’re mostly stuck with due to design decisions in the surface language.
These things mean that despite Go having a GC, it’s possible to do manual memory management in pure Go and in cooperation with the GC (although without any help from the
runtime
package). To demonstrate this, we will be building an untyped, garbage-collected arena abstraction in Go which relies on several GC implementation details.
I would never play this kind of game in Rust or C++, because LLVM is extremely intelligent and able to find all kinds of ways to break you over the course of frequent compiler upgrades. On the other hand, although Go does not promise any compatibility across versions for code that imports
unsafe
, in practice, two forces work against Go doing this:
Go does not attempt to define what is and isn’t allowed:
unsafe
lacks any
operational semantics
.
Go prioritizes not breaking the ecosystem; this allows to assume that
Hyrum’s Law
will protect certain observable behaviors of the runtime, from which we may infer what can or cannot break easily.
This is in contrast to a high-performance native compiler like LLVM, which has a carefully defined boundary around all UB, allowing them to arbitrarily break programs that cross it (mostly) without fear of breaking the ecosystem.

arena

data.title: Evertop: E-ink IBM XT clone with 100+ hours of battery life
data.author: harryvederci
data.article_summary:
Evertop是一款超低功耗、超长电池寿命的太阳能便携电脑，仿IBM XT，搭载80186处理器和1MB内存，可运行DOS、Minix等1980年代操作系统，甚至支持Windows 3.0。它采用E-ink显示器，配备两块10,000mAh电池，并通过极端省电措施实现数百至数千小时的续航。内置太阳能板，可在离网情况下无限期使用。

设备包含丰富的内置外设，如内置键盘、PS/2接口、多种图形和音频支持、以太网和WiFi、LoRA无线电等。充电方式多样，包括太阳能板、DC输入和Micro USB。在省电模式下，续航可达200至500小时，甚至更长。

Evertop采用ESP32微控制器，5.83英寸648x480 E-ink显示屏，支持多系统启动和256GB SD卡存储，用于磁盘映像。设备还支持自动休眠和断电功能，以进一步节省电量。

• Karunamurti对DOOM的关注：Karunamurti幽默地表示对DOOM运行在设备上的关注。

Evertop: an ultra lower power, ultra long battery solar PC
Overview
Evertop is a portable PC that emulates an IBM XT with an 80186 processor and 1MB RAM. It can run DOS, Minix, and some other old 1980s operating systems.  It also runs Windows up to version 3.0.  Because it's based on a powerful yet very low power microcontroller, uses an e-ink display, packs two 10,000mAh batteries, and implements extreme power saving measures, it can run for hundreds or even thousands of hours on a single charge.  Combine that with its built in solar panel, and you should be able to use it indefinitely off grid without ever having to worry about battery life.
Loaded with built-in peripherals
It features a built in keyboard, external PS/2 keyboard and mouse ports, full CGA, Hercules, and MCGA graphics support, partial EGA and VGA support, PC speaker, Adlib, Covox, and Disney Sound Source audio output, built in speaker and headphone jack with volume control wheel, one DB9 RS232 serial port, one TTL serial port, dual keyboard and mouse PS/2 ports, USB flash drive port for convenient file transfer, an RJ45 ethernet port, wifi, and LoRA radio (I wrote a LoRA realtime chat client in QBASIC in about 15 minutes).  Bluetooth hardware is present but I have not yet implemented it in any features, though I plan to add support for BT keyboard and mouse, and maybe serial over BT, IP over BT, audio over BT, and BT file transfer.  The keyboard can be easily detached on a short tether to make it convenient to prop up the device at an angle while placing the keyboard on a flat surface.  Or you can just plug in your own to the PS/2 port, as sometimes it's nice to be able to use a full sized keyboard, though the one I built into this device is big enough for normal typing.
Charging options for every scenario
There are three ways you can power and charge this compputer: 1.) built in detachable solar panel, 2.) 2.5 - 20V DC input via an internal buck/boost circuit, or 3.) micro USB connector.  It can charge from all three sources simultaneously, and of course charge in every way while in use.  I also added a built in voltmeter to facilitate easy battery level and charge voltage monitoring.
Hundreds to thousands of hours on a single charge
In power saving mode it can run between 200 hours on the low side and 500 hours or in some cases even much longer of constant interactive use,
not
standby.  That should afford ample opportunity to find some sunny weather and recharge the batteries long before they start getting low.  I'm also going to port over a simple native (non-emulated) text editor / word processor and e-reader that I made several years ago for a similar pocket device.  I'm hoping I can get over 1000 hours of constant use on a single charge with those, maybe even 5000-10000 hours on the e-reader app.  Evertop also features optional user initiated or automatic hibernate to disk and automatic total power shutoff via an IO controlled dual MOSFET circuit, so you can set it to hibernate and it will completely shut off power when idle, then when you power back on you can resume right where yo left off.  Internal peripherals can be shut off when not in use via physical switches on the front panel to ensure no power is being wasted.  The solar panel is rated at 6V and 6W, so theoretically it should be able to produce 1 amp with full sunlight.  The most I've ever seen it do is 700mA, but even that's enough to provide ten to fifty hours of constant use from each hour of sunlight.  And even on the dimmest cloudy days it still gets around 70-100mA, which at least gives can give one to five hours of use per hour of charge.
Storage
I've been using a 256G SD card to store floppy and hard disk images, larger cards might work but I haven't tested one yet.  Hard drive images can be up to 4G each.  Emulated systems can mount two floppies and two hard drives for a total of 8G per emulated system.  You can set up multiple emulated systems and choose which one to boot at startup, or just default to the previous choice.

Under the hood it's powered by an Espressif ESP32 microcontroller.  The display is a 5.83 inch 648x480 (yes, 648 with the 8) "fast refresh" model from good-display.com which uses no power when not refreshing.  I started out using Fabrizio Di Vittorio's amazing and excellent PCEmu
43757037.article_summary:
Evertop是一款超低功耗、超长电池寿命的太阳能便携电脑，仿IBM XT，搭载80186处理器和1MB内存，可运行DOS、Minix等1980年代操作系统，甚至支持Windows 3.0。它采用E-ink显示器，配备两块10,000mAh电池，并通过极端省电措施实现数百至数千小时的续航。内置太阳能板，可在离网情况下无限期使用。

设备包含丰富的内置外设，如内置键盘、PS/2接口、多种图形和音频支持、以太网和WiFi、LoRA无线电等。充电方式多样，包括太阳能板、DC输入和Micro USB。在省电模式下，续航可达200至500小时，甚至更长。

Evertop采用ESP32微控制器，5.83英寸648x480 E-ink显示屏，支持多系统启动和256GB SD卡存储，用于磁盘映像。设备还支持自动休眠和断电功能，以进一步节省电量。

不同观点：
• Kovac对显示屏寿命的关注：Kovac对电子墨水屏的显示寿命感兴趣，提到自己使用的Waveshare显示屏最多有100万次刷新周期，并分享了自己的一些项目链接。

data.author: wilson090

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Nvidia的竞争地位及未来发展前景

不同观点：
• [01100011] 认为许多人低估了Nvidia的应对能力，尽管有很多人试图竞争，但Nvidia不会坐以待毙。历史上许多唱衰Nvidia的人最终都失败了，因此现在预言Nvidia会失败也为时过早。
• [ivape] 对Nvidia持乐观态度，认为其硬件领先地位稳固，且对Nvidia的多元化发展（如AI手机、自动驾驶汽车、机器人等）抱有信心。同时提到，即便未来GPU无法完全取代云计算，Nvidia依然有巨大潜力，甚至可能成为10万亿美元的公司。
• [otistravel] 强调Nvidia不仅仅依赖硬件优势，而是在构建整个AI生态系统，包括硬件、网络、软件、模型和开发工具。这种综合性平台战略使得Nvidia在行业中占据独特位置，可能成为行业标准。
• [lvl155] 提出AMD可能与Nvidia有某种默契或合作，因为两者在市场上的垄断地位（特别是在TSMC的芯片供应上）使得Nvidia在未来两年内仍将保持市场主导地位。
• [Havoc] 认为Nvidia正从功能性垄断转向竞争环境，尽管竞争加剧，但这并不意味着Nvidia会遭遇重大挫折。
• [alephnerd] 强调Nvidia通过其生态系统工具（如CUDA、Infiniband、NVLink等）建立了强大的生态系统，未来可以通过扩展服务和应用（如AI Foundry和集群管理）来应对市场变化并实现盈利。
• [echelon] 认为尽管H100系列的定价能力可能达到顶峰，但短期内没有替代品意味着Nvidia将继续获得大量现金流。同时提出长期来看（>6年），超大规模企业（如Google、Microsoft、Amazon、Meta）的自主芯片开发可能会对Nvidia构成威胁。

补充讨论：
• [cornhole] 和 [ein0p] 对Nvidia的GPU驱动程序质量问题存在争议。cornhole认为Nvidia的驱动程序质量在下降，而ein0p则反驳说Nvidia的产品依然供不应求，驱动问题并未影响其销售。
• [mkoubaa] 提到，当主流媒体（如Financial Times）开始唱衰Nvidia时，反而是买入的好时机，暗示对Nvidia未来表现的信心。

争议焦点：
• Nvidia是否能够在长期竞争中保持其主导地位，特别是在面对超大规模企业的自主芯片开发时。
• Nvidia驱动程序质量是否影响了其产品表现和市场反应。

总结：讨论围绕Nvidia在硬件、软件生态、市场竞争及未来发展潜力等多个维度展开，参与者对其短期和长期表现存在不同看法，但普遍认可其当前的市场主导地位和技术优势。

data.title: Ultra-precision formation flying demonstration for space-based interferometry
data.author: PaulHoule
data.article_summary: 文章介绍了一个名为SILVIA（Space Interferometer Laboratory Voyaging towards Innovative Applications）的任务概念，旨在展示三艘航天器之间100米尺度上的超精密编队飞行。SILVIA目标是通过集成航天器传感器、激光干涉测量、低推力和低噪声微推进技术，实现亚微米级的相对距离控制，实时测量和控制航天器之间的距离和相对姿态。该任务设置在近地低轨道，平衡了相对扰动小和碰撞风险低的优势，为未来引力波观测台（如DECIGO）和直接成像系外行星热辐射的高对比度干涉仪（如LIFE）等任务奠定了技术基础。文章概述了任务概念及其关键技术，为下一代高精度太空观测站铺平道路。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：PROBA-3 mission及其干涉测量技术的应用和潜力

不同观点：
• **ggm**：对PROBA-3的精度感到惊讶，特别是相对于射电干涉仪的精度而言。他认为光学干涉仪的精度可能需要更小的尺度，而射电干涉仪通常需要更大的距离（公里甚至数百公里）才能有效。他提到固定位置的射电望远镜（如Narrabri射电望远镜和SKA）作为对比，强调了不同类型的干涉仪在距离和精度上的差异。

• **ziofill**：从光学工作台上的干涉仪对齐难度出发，认为PROBA-3任务的技术要求非常高，尤其是在没有固定装置的情况下实现如此高的精度，显得不可思议。

• **dvh**：以一种半开玩笑的方式提出PROBA-3是否会测试三角形内角和是否为180度，暗示对该任务科学目标的质疑或调侃。

• **hydrogen7800**：提到重力恢复与气候实验（GRACE）及其第三期任务，使用干涉测量技术绘制重力异常图。他认为这与PROBA-3有相似之处，但应用领域不同，强调了干涉测量技术在不同科学任务中的广泛应用。

• **aerostable_slug**：认为PROBA-3技术具有双重用途，特别是用于通过射频发射定位目标，提到美国海军的NOSS、法国的CERES以及中国的一些Yaogan军事卫星集群，暗示该技术可能具有军事应用潜力。

• **Animats**：认为该技术对恒星日冕仪寻找太阳系外行星非常有用，尤其是使用不透明圆盘遮挡恒星以观测行星。他提到JPL曾考虑这种方法但选择了更传统的设计，暗示PROBA-3的任务设计具有创新性和潜在的优势。

• **londons_explore**：提出大气密度的微小变化可能是该任务的限制因素，并建议通过飞得更高来解决这一问题，关注的是任务在大气层高空中的执行环境。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是PROBA-3的精度和干涉距离的关系，特别是在不同类型的干涉仪（光学与射电）之间的比较。
• 另一个值得注意的点是对该技术潜在军事应用的讨论，如aerostable_slug提到的双重用途可能性。
• 最后，不同用户对该任务科学目标和设计选择的看法也有所不同，从质疑到认可其创新性。

View PDF
HTML (experimental)
Abstract:
We propose SILVIA (Space Interferometer Laboratory Voyaging towards Innovative Applications), a mission concept designed to demonstrate ultra-precision formation flying between three spacecraft separated by 100 m. SILVIA aims to achieve sub-micrometer precision in relative distance control by integrating spacecraft sensors, laser interferometry, low-thrust and low-noise micro-propulsion for real-time measurement and control of distances and relative orientations between spacecraft. A 100-meter-scale mission in a near-circular low Earth orbit has been identified as an ideal, cost-effective setting for demonstrating SILVIA, as this configuration maintains a good balance between small relative perturbations and low risk for collision. This mission will fill the current technology gap towards future missions, including gravitational wave observatories such as DECIGO (DECihertz Interferometer Gravitational wave Observatory), designed to detect the primordial gravitational wave background, and high-contrast nulling infrared interferometers like LIFE (Large Interferometer for Exoplanets), designed for direct imaging of thermal emissions from nearby terrestrial planet candidates. The mission concept and its key technologies are outlined, paving the way for the next generation of high-precision space-based observatories.

• **hydrogen7800**：提到重力恢复与气候实验（GRACE）及其第三期任务，使用干涉测量技术绘制重力异常图。他认为这与PROBA-3有相似之处，但应用领域不同，强调了干涉测量技术在不同科学任务中的广泛应用。

• **aerostable_slug**：认为PROBA-3技术具有双重用途，特别是用于通过射频发射定位目标，提到美国海军的NOSS、法国的CERES以及中国的一些Yaogan军事卫星集群，暗示该技术可能具有军事应用潜力。

• **Animats**：认为该技术对恒星日冕仪寻找太阳系外行星非常有用，尤其是使用不透明圆盘遮挡恒星以观测行星。他提到JPL曾考虑这种方法但选择了更传统的设计，暗示PROBA-3的任务设计具有创新性和潜在的优势。

• **londons_explore**：提出大气密度的微小变化可能是该任务的限制因素，并建议通过飞得更高来解决这一问题，关注的是任务在大气层高空中的执行环境。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是PROBA-3的精度和干涉距离的关系，特别是在不同类型的干涉仪（光学与射电）之间的比较。
• 另一个值得注意的点是对该技术潜在军事应用的讨论，如aerostable_slug提到的双重用途可能性。
• 最后，不同用户对该任务科学目标和设计选择的看法也有所不同，从质疑到认可其创新性。

Business Cards by Kolyder
Strategic execution. Hostile takeovers. Bullet points. Post-mortems.
Business is war. Your career is a battlefield.
Welcome, valued colleague, to Business Cards by Kolyder.
"I showed these to my boss. She said this was a teachable moment and now I have more 'development opportunities' than ever!"
Chad Chadton
Disillusionment Engineer
"Perfect for when you've abandoned hope but still have student loans to pay."
Vivian Woods
Email Warfare Specialist
"I played the 'Weaponized Incompetence' and 'Just Add AI' cards so often I was promoted to a position with the word 'Innovation' in the title."
Bryson P. Weatherby III
SVP, Innovative Ambiguity
Questions and Answers
What in the fresh hell is this?
Expand
Questions are not allowed during this meeting. Frankly, I'm not sure how you were unmuted.
Should I share these with co-workers?
Expand
Absolutely! Business Cards offer that perfect blend of potential unemployment and trivial amusement.
Is this a proper allocation of resources?
Expand
Almost certainly not. But you play the cards you’re delt.
Should I report this to HR?
Expand
If you do, we’ll report you for taking that sick day to snowboard last year.
Is this a real game?
Expand
The cards? No. Your career? Yes. Play on, my friend.
What if my CEO sees these?
Expand
Depends. Are they chill? Do they have a sense of self-awareness?
Really, why would you do this?
Expand
As a child growing up in rural Nebraska, I spent many hours outdoors trying to conjure orbs with my mind. Naturally, I was inclined to like Magic: The Gathering.
I still spend a lot of time conjuring things with my mind. Not orbs, but marketing strategies for companies. I take my work seriously. Myself? Not so much. These Business Cards are an homage to something I enjoyed.

let's connect

data.title: Pydrofoil: Accelerating Sail-based instruction set simulators
data.author: luu
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了一种名为Pydrofoil的多阶段编译器，它可以从高层次、面向验证的ISA规范语言Sail生成指令集模拟器（ISS）。Pydrofoil通过结合提前编译（AOT）和即时追踪编译（JIT），实现了比Sail生成的C语言ISS快230倍以上的速度。其关键在于：ISS类似于解释器循环，追踪JIT编译器能有效加速这类工作负载；ISS工作负载以大量位操作主导，常规编译优化效果有限，需要特定领域的优化；单独使用AOT或JIT均不足以生成高性能ISS，Pydrofoil的混合方法则显著提升了性能。

Title:
Pydrofoil: accelerating Sail-based instruction set simulators
Authors:

View a PDF of the paper titled Pydrofoil: accelerating Sail-based instruction set simulators, by Carl Friedrich Bolz-Tereick and Luke Panayi and Ferdia McKeogh and Tom Spink and Martin Berger
View PDF
HTML (experimental)
Abstract:
We present Pydrofoil, a multi-stage compiler that generates instruction set simulators (ISSs) from processor instruction set architectures (ISAs) expressed in the high-level, verification-oriented ISA specification language Sail. Pydrofoil shows a > 230x speedup over the C-based ISS generated by Sail on our benchmarks, and is based on the following insights. (i) An ISS is effectively an interpreter loop, and tracing just-in-time (JIT) compilers have proven effective at accelerating those, albeit mostly for dynamically typed languages. (ii) ISS workloads are highly atypical, dominated by intensive bit manipulation operations. Conventional compiler optimisations for general-purpose programming languages have limited impact for speeding up such workloads. We develop suitable domain-specific optimisations. (iii) Neither tracing JIT compilers, nor ahead-of-time (AOT) compilation alone, even with domain-specific optimisations, suffice for the generation of performant ISSs. Pydrofoil therefore implements a hybrid approach, pairing an AOT compiler with a tracing JIT built on the meta-tracing PyPy framework. AOT and JIT use domain-specific optimisations. Our benchmarks demonstrate that combining AOT and JIT compilers provides significantly greater performance gains than using either compiler alone.

data.title: 101 BASIC Computer Games
data.author: sohkamyung
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了由maurymarkowitz整理的101个BASIC计算机游戏程序，这些程序来源于1975年出版的David Ahl的《101 BASIC Computer Games》一书。该集合包含了原始的DEC和Dartmouth方言编写的程序，与后来更著名的《BASIC Computer Games》（BCG）不同，两者包含的游戏和使用的BASIC方言有所不同。该集合展示了早期编程的多样性，如不同方言使用不同的语法和编程风格，例如使用`\`或`:`分隔语句，以及使用`&`代替`PRINT`等。这些程序大多通过OCR技术转换，并在RetroBASIC上运行良好，旨在提供示例代码以改进该程序。集合中的游戏示例包括ACEYDU、AMAZIN、ANIMAL、AWARI等，涵盖了不同的BASIC方言和玩法。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：寻找适合现代Windows系统的类QBASIC编程工具及对早期BASIC编程的怀旧讨论

不同观点：
• [zabzonk] 认为需要一个适合现代Windows系统的类QBASIC工具，且不希望使用DOSBox等模拟器。他建议让其哥哥使用Python，但觉得BASIC可能更符合其需求，因为其哥哥已经退休，编程只是为了兴趣。
• [0xEF] 提到了Micro Adventure系列书籍，这些书籍曾是BASIC编程学习的一部分，并提供了购买链接。
• [vunderba] 建议使用DOS模拟器如DosBox-X，并安装Quickbasic 4.5，认为现代变种如QB64虽然存在，但失去了BASIC原有的解释性语言魅力。
• [carrja99] 分享了自己童年时通过书籍学习编写BASIC游戏的愉快经历。
• [saneshark] 特别提到对“gorillas.bas”游戏的喜爱，并通过修改代码来增强游戏体验。

补充讨论：
• [chasil] 提到了多个平台上的BASIC变种及其作者，提供了一些参考书籍链接，展示了BASIC在不同平台上的广泛应用。
• [musicale] 表达了对BASIC时代及PC时代乌托邦式计算愿景的怀旧，并对现代商业计算和AI时代的发展表示一定的失望。
• [jasperry] 和 [Erwin] 提到了在不同平台上学习BASIC编程的经历，并讨论了不同BASIC方言之间的差异，如Commodore和Amiga上的BASIC。
• [genghisjahn] 和 [wduquette] 分享了自己在Amiga和C64上学习编程的愉快回忆，特别是对无行号编程的喜爱。
• [sudofoo] 提出了关于旧BASIC游戏中行号是否真正有用的问题。
• [dang] 提供了一个相关的讨论链接，更新“101 Basic Computer Games”以适应2021年的需求。
• [zombot] 幽默地将“poet.bas”视为所有LLM（大型语言模型）的祖先。

争议焦点：
• 使用DOS模拟器如DOSBox与寻找纯Windows原生解决方案的偏好不同。
• 对BASIC从解释性语言转向编译型语言是否失去原有魅力的讨论。

101 BASIC Computer Games
This folder contains the programs found in the March 1975 3rd printing of David Ahl's
101 BASIC Computer Games
, published by Digital Equipment Corp. You can download all of the programs in a single archive using the
Releases
link to the right.
Contrary to popular belief, 101 is
not
the same as the later and more famous
BASIC Computer Games
(BCG) published by Ahl through Creative Computing. A number of the games in this collection did not appear in BCG, and vice versa. In comparison to BCG's used of Microsoft-like BASIC, the source in this book spans several different and sometimes incompatible dialects. For instance, CAN-AM is in its original Dartmouth version, and BATTLE appears to be HP 2100. In some cases the dialect is mentioned in the book, but in most it's not and the listing below is a best-guess based on the syntax.
This collection is an excellent example of the different dialects and programming styles one found at the time. ANIMAL is almost a different language than ACEYDU although they are both from DEC, while AWARI illustrates the editing style that made BASIC infamous. Even within the DEC examples we have differences in things like using
\
to separate statements instead of
:
, the use of
&
as the short form for
PRINT
instead of
?
, and the other oddities of BASIC-PLUS.
This collection was prepared with the help of the OCR in Gemini AI, ChatGTP and Le Chat. In contrast to other collections, like
PCC
, the print quality of this book is fairly good and most of the programs were converted with minimal problems. See the
NOTES
for some oddities to look for.
Many of these programs will run correctly without editing under
RetroBASIC
, and one of the reasons for creating this collection is to provide example code to improve that program.
